identity.parserAndSerializer: For imported direct rectangle/ellipse children at groupLevel=1, id is stored in CommonObjAttr.instance_id and instid in DrawingObjAttr.inst_id as independent u32 values. The scoped presence flags preserve explicit zero and omission in write_rect and render_common_shape_xml. The parent container path continues to use its common instance ID. Generated drawings use generated common and drawing IDs.
identity.baseline: Reading (0,1) produced (1,1). Writing (1,0) produced (1,1), so distinct identities could converge after publication.
identity.ownership: A supplied child index must identify a child with the expected id and instId in the live parent. A missing attribute contributes 0 to the tuple and stays omitted in XML. A child with no nonzero ID is ineligible. Duplicate tuples refuse group-child geometry. I1-I9 cover eligible one-zero children, omission, duplicates, wrong IDs and index, and round-trip stability.

rawRendering.parserInvariant: parse_rendering_info reads matrices into [f64;6] arrays, fills a missing member of a scale/rotation pair with identity, and make_raw_rendering writes the u16 count, 48-byte translation, and 96 bytes per complete pair. A missing rendering block leaves the buffer empty. An XML reader error returns XmlError. Even a pair count above u16::MAX would yield an overlong buffer relative to the wrapped header, so valid external HWPX cannot create an internally truncated buffer.
